revisions.observation: The product looked composited rather than naturally present in the room.
revisions.rejectedState: Deterministic product cutout placed over a separately generated or animated room.
revisions.acceptedChange: Generate one unified product-and-environment still from the official product reference, then animate the unified plate.
evidence: User explicitly rejected the compositing approach.
verification: Unified generated room plate reviewed before animation.

revisions.observation: One generated still was not sufficient for a four-scene product introduction.
revisions.rejectedState: Reuse one generated cinematic image while changing motion or crop.
revisions.acceptedChange: Generate a dedicated GPT Image 2 keyframe from a product reference and scene prompt for every scene.
evidence: User required a new cinematic image for each scene.

revisions.observation: The first Scene 2 generation invented exposed upper hardware.
revisions.rejectedState: Generated product assembly that did not match the official brass-and-shade reference.
revisions.acceptedChange: Regenerate from one correct reference image and reject the mutated result rather than cropping or covering it.
evidence: First Scene 2 generation rejected during visual review.
verification: Corrected Scene 2 still retained the pale linen shade, simple brass neck, and smoked base.

revisions.observation: The first final-room image made the lamp shade too narrow relative to the base.
revisions.rejectedState: Whole-product room image with incorrect major proportion.
revisions.acceptedChange: Regenerate with the shade approximately 1.7 times the base width and preserve three sculptural body sections.

revisions.observation: Large or complex motion increased risk of temporal product drift.
revisions.rejectedState: Product-driven movement or aggressive camera choreography.
revisions.acceptedChange: Animate each still as a moving photograph with one subtle camera move and minimal environmental motion.
verification: Start, midpoint, and end frames reviewed for all four clips.

revisions.observation: Scene 3's white panel read like a card over the footage and weakened the material study.
revisions.rejectedState: Opaque white rectangular copy panel with a border.
revisions.acceptedChange: Remove the panel and border; place white headline, support copy, and hairline directly over the dark amber product plate.
verification: Final Scene 3 snapshot remained legible without obscuring the product.

revisions.observation: Dark copy and sentence-case headers did not feel strong enough over the cinematic footage.
revisions.rejectedState: Black primary copy and sentence-case display lines.
revisions.acceptedChange: Use white copy throughout and uppercase primary scene lines.
evidence: User requested white text and all-caps headers.

revisions.observation: White Scene 2 copy failed contrast over the pale wall.
revisions.rejectedState: White text with text shadow only.
revisions.acceptedChange: Add a soft heritage-green edge-to-transparent scrim behind the right-side copy area.
evidence: Initial contrast sample failed at 1.75:1 and later 4.15:1.
verification: Final 3/3 sampled text checks passed WCAG AA.

revisions.observation: The header font was too tightly spaced relative to the official One Kings Lane wordmark, and support type varied by scene.
revisions.rejectedState: Generic serif with negative tracking and mixed serif/sans support copy.
revisions.acceptedChange: Use deterministic EB Garamond for primary lines at 0.06em tracking and deterministic Inter at 1.4cqw for every supporting line.
evidence: User requested wider header tracking and persistent subtext type.
verification: HyperFrames loaded only EB Garamond and Inter deterministic font faces.
Preview and render font families now resolve identically.

revisions.observation: Reassembly removed previously hoisted video plates and left typography over empty backgrounds.
revisions.rejectedState: Destructive frame-video hoisting that was not idempotent.
revisions.acceptedChange: Restore approved video declarations, reassemble, restore media transitions, and require an idempotent media manifest or reconstructable declaration.
evidence: Contact sheet captured empty product scenes after reassembly.
verification: Full contact sheet showed all four moving plates.
Runtime, layout, motion, and contrast checks passed.

revisions.observation: A render can make an unapproved state look final and incur avoidable work.
revisions.rejectedState: Automatic MP4 render before the user reviewed the Studio preview.
revisions.acceptedChange: Keep final rendering approval-gated after contact-sheet and live-preview review.
verification: Project marked approved in preview; final MP4 remains unrendered until separately requested.
